Cargo.lock brings pageant in through russh-keys. Searches of the shipped CLI and SSH implementation found server-side key loading and authentication but no local SSH-agent client or Pageant invocation. The advisory concerns the Windows agent client's shared-memory reply path.

Premier SSH uses CryptoVec from russh, and the lockfile includes russh-cryptovec in the network-facing SSH stack. Upgrade russh and its resolved cryptovec dependency together to patched versions so the service uses the corrected buffer implementation.

The Premier SSH listener hands accepted network connections to russh::server::run_stream for SSH negotiation and session handling. The listener exposes this dependency to remote clients. Upgrade russh to a version that addresses the reported advisories, and check server and client applicability separately during the upgrade.
